Job description 
 Our client specializes in solving logistical challenges that others cannot handle. Whether it’s a large machine part, a box of special screws, or medical equipment, their drivers ensure every delivery is handled carefully and delivered on time. 
For this position, we are looking for a driver with a strong sense of responsibility.
 What does the job involve? 
    
• Daily start times vary between 05:00 and 08:00, with your schedule sent by SMS the evening before
    
• Finishing times are flexible, as new assignments can come in throughout the day
    
• You will drive across the Benelux and occasionally beyond, delivering to hospitals, factories, and companies in cities such as Rotterdam, Amsterdam, and Brussels
    
• You transport one load per trip (dedicated transport): directly from point A to point B
    
• After a delivery in places like Düsseldorf, you may continue through Amsterdam and Antwerp before returning home
    
• Some days involve only national trips, usually shorter routes but following the same dedicated transport principle
    
• You will cover many kilometers while generally being home every weekend
    
• Most assignments are day trips, although overnight stays in the truck are possible by agreement
 Flexibility & work-life balance 
The dispatcher takes your private schedule into account whenever possible with timely communication, but flexibility remains essential for this role.
 Depot location 
Your truck starts and ends each day at the depot in Duffel, so having your own transport to reach the location is required.

 Requirements 

    
• CE driving license + Code 95
    
• Strong sense of responsibility
    
• Independent working attitude
    
• Good knowledge of the European road network
    
• Dutch-speaking or good command of English

Job description 

At this correct company with a family atmosphere, you will drive with clean and well-maintained equipment and primarily do large distribution of pallet goods in the Benelux, France, and Germany.

You will leave early and drive for quite a few hours, but you will still sleep in your own bed every night. You will receive your schedule via the onboard computer (Transics), so you can usually depart from home.

All hours are paid, and in case of any issues, you can always rely on the planning team that will support you. So, if you are a motivated driver with some experience who wants to earn a good income while being home every day, please contact us, and we will ensure you can start quickly!

 Requirements 

    
• License C/CE with the necessary certificates
    
• Good knowledge of the European road network
    
• Physically fit, you load & unload yourself
    
• Experience as a driver and within the sector
    
• Independent, safety, and collegial are some of your keywords
    
• Good knowledge of Dutch/English

Job description 

Earn like an international driver while being home every day!

    
• Collection of waste and press containers with recycled paper
    
• Daily trips within Belgium to companies
    
• Flexible start times between 03:00 and 06:00
    
• Average of 12 working hours per day, with the possibility to work more if desired
    
• 2 to 5 trips per day
    
• Experience with hook lift systems and truck-trailer combinations is a plus, but can be learned on the job
    
• Work from Monday to Friday, with occasional Saturdays in consultation
    
• Hours above 38/week and Saturday hours paid at 150%
    
• Preferably living in the Antwerp, Turnhout, or Hoogstraten region
    
• Permanent contract after a successful interim period
    
• More working hours = higher salary

Interested? Apply now!

 Requirements 

    
• CE driving license
    
• Valid Code 95
    
• Experience is required
    
• Flexible attitude
    
• Dutch-speaking or good command of English
    
• Departure from Merksem

Job description 

As our new Distribution Driver, you will deliver goods on euro-pallets to clients within your region. No heavy lifting required—you’ll be using an electric pallet jack!

    
• 
        
Hours: Full-time, averaging 10 hours per day.

    
    
• 
        
Schedule: Monday to Friday (weekends off).

    
    
• 
        
Stops: 15 to 25 customer deliveries per day.

    
    
• 
        
Start time: 07:00 AM.

    
    
• 
        
Region: Mainly West Flanders, with occasional trips to East Flanders and Wallonia.

    

 

 Requirements 

    
• 
        
Valid Category C driving license.

    
    
• 
        
Based near Gullegem.

    
    
• 
        
Experience in distribution is a major plus.

    
    
• 
        
Flexible enough to occasionally drive a delivery van.

    
    
• 
        
Independent, proactive, safety-conscious, and customer-friendly.

    
    
• 
        
Fluent in Dutch, French, or English.

Job description 

You will be responsible for delivering meat to companies, distribution centers, or supermarkets with a refrigerated trailer.

Possibility of driving shuttles between the customer and distribution centers.

Loading at the processor and 2 to 3 stops per day. Unloading at the dock or using the loading bridge and electric pallet truck.

Working from Monday to Friday.

 

 Requirements 

    
• CE driver's license with a valid C95.
    
• You have initial experience in refrigerated transport.
    
• You are Dutch or speak English well.
    
• Shifts from 10 to 13 hours per day.
    
• Good, open communication with planning/management.

Job description 

Due to expansion, several modern trucks are ready for new drivers to embark on international journeys!

Join our family-owned company where safety, reliability, and professionalism come first.

Your Role:

    
• 
        
Conduct international transport across the Benelux, Germany, and France.

    
    
• 
        
Handle specialized cargo, such as heated liquids.

    
    
• 
        
Work primarily Monday morning to Friday evening, with occasional rotational weekends.

    
    
• 
        
Opportunities for national day trips in some cases.

    

Requirements:

    
• 
        
ADR certification is mandatory.

    
    
• 
        
Previous driving experience.

    
    
• 
        
Strong sense of responsibility and reliability.

    

What We Offer:

    
• 
        
Full-time, 6-day schedule with all hours fairly compensated.

    
    
• 
        
Thorough training and supervision during the first 6 months.

    
    
• 
        
Permanent contract after a successful probationary period.

    
    
• 
        
Modern, well-equipped trucks and a supportive work environment.

    

Interested? Quick responses mean a quick start! If you have any questions about the position, don’t hesitate to contact us.

 Requirements 

We are looking for a motivated professional who meets the following requirements:

    
• Driver's License CE: You must possess a valid CE driver's license.
    
• ADR Tank: You have a valid ADR tank certificate.
    
• Experience: You have experience as an international CE driver.
    
• Accuracy and Safety-Conscious: You work accurately and have a strong focus on safety.
    
• Willingness to Work: You are willing to work two weeks per month.
    
• Language Skills: You have a good command of Dutch and/or English.

If this appeals to you, we warmly invite you to apply!

Robert Half is currently recruiting a Platform Engineer (M/V/X) - Antwerp

Our client is an innovative and rapidly growing organization operating at the intersection of technology, payments, and operations. 

The scope of responsibilities for this job include:

• You manage, monitor, and optimize platform components, integrations, and operational workflows.
• You analyze alerts, logs, and technical incidents, and you contribute to structural improvements.
• You support critical operational processes, incidents, and escalations when required.
• You build, configure, and support integrations with banks, core banking systems, card platforms, and payment providers.
• You support technical changes, testing, deployments, and releases in close collaboration with business teams, operations, and vendors.
• You help deliver new solutions and platform capabilities into production in a reliable and controlled manner.
• You contribute to the security, availability, and reliability of the platforms.
• You automate operational controls, monitoring activities, and repetitive tasks whenever possible.
• You support incident response, business continuity, and disaster recovery activities.
• You document technical components, processes, dependencies, and known solutions.
• You collaborate with operations teams to address recurring operational issues and drive long-term improvements.
• You support root cause analyses, SLA monitoring, and continuous improvement initiatives.

The requested qualifications for this job as Platform Engineer (M/V/X) include:

• You hold a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Applied Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or you bring equivalent experience.
• You have experience with platform operations, backend integrations, APIs, monitoring, incident analysis, and release support.
• You have knowledge of cloud platforms, networking, identity management, SSO, logging, scripting, or CI/CD.
• You work in a structured way and know how to document and manage complex technical environments.
• You bring strong analytical skills and a continuous focus on quality, security, and operational excellence.
• You communicate fluently in Dutch and English, both written and spoken.
• You have a broad interest in platforms, integrations, and operational technology, and you enjoy solving technical problems.
• Experience in payments, banking, fintech, payroll, or other transactional platforms is a strong asset, as is knowledge of DevSecOps, security controls, business continuity, or disaster recovery.

Senhive is a technology leader specialising in advanced counter-drone systems and autonomous sensor networks designed for high-security and mission-critical environments. Leveraging cutting-edge detection, tracking, and mitigation technologies, Senhive provides robust, real-time solutions in support of air traffic management systems and protects airspace from unauthorized or hostile drone activity. Serving defence, aerospace, security and critical infrastructure sectors, Senhive enhances situational awareness and operational security through intelligent, scalable, and resilient systems.
 

Job description
 

As Purchasing & Logistics Assistant, you will play a key role in keeping our purchasing and logistics operations running smoothly. You will ensure that the materials and components our teams need are ordered on time, that deliveries are properly received and processed, and that outgoing shipments are prepared accurately and efficiently.
 

Your responsibilities cover the entire operational flow, from placing purchase orders and coordinating with suppliers to checking incoming invoices and preparing shipments for customers and partners. When products are unavailable or delivery dates change, you take the initiative to find suitable alternatives and keep things moving.
 

In addition to the above, you will also contribute to the smooth day-to-day running of our office by taking care of a range of general and very practical facility and office management tasks.
 

This is a hands-on role combining practical warehouse and logistics activities with administrative & office-related responsibilities. We are therefore looking for someone who works proactively, takes ownership of their responsibilities and naturally spots what needs to be done. You enjoy bringing structure to day-to-day operations, solving practical problems and making sure things get done without having to be asked twice.
 

More details in PDF file enclosed.
 

 

Your profile
 

We are looking for someone who is organised, proactive and hands-on, with a strong sense of ownership and a practical approach to problem-solving.
 

You have:
 

• At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in purchasing, logistics, supply chain, warehouse administration or a comparable operational role. 
• Excellent knowledge of Dutch and English, both written and spoken). 
• Strong administrative skills and an eye for detail, particularly when handling orders, delivery documents and invoices. 
• The ability to organise your work independently, set priorities and follow up on outstanding tasks. 
• A proactive mindset: you identify what needs attention, anticipate potential issues and take action without waiting for instructions. 
• A solution-oriented attitude and the ability to find practical alternatives when things do not go according to plan. 
• The flexibility to switch between administrative tasks and hands-on operational work throughout the day. 
• Confidence in communicating with suppliers, couriers, colleagues and other external contacts. 
• A reliable and structured approach, with a strong focus on accuracy, follow-up and getting things done. 
• A willingness to take ownership of both the bigger picture and the smaller practical details that keep an organisation running smoothly.
 

You are comfortable working at a desk when the task requires it, but you are equally happy to receive deliveries, check goods and take care of practical logistics activities. You understand that a well-functioning operation depends on both accurate administration and effective execution.
 

Given the practical and on-site nature of this role, you live within maximum 30 minutes' driving distance of our workplace in Hasselt.
 

Experience with purchase order systems, ERP software, courier platforms and international shipping documentation is an advantage.

For our client, an international player within logistics with several branches worldwide and in Belgium, we are looking for a GL Accountant.

They offer various logistics solutions through their extensive network of offices, partners and warehouses.

They are looking to strengthen their team in Antwerp and are looking for a GL Accountant.

Jobomschrijving

For the position as GL Accountant at our client in the Antwerp region, we are looking for someone who is fascinated by the following range of tasks:

• You will process the complete accounting for the assigned companies and countries.
• You prepare the monthly and annual financial close of the assigned entities.
• You align accounting and operational processes.
• You will be responsible for the balance sheet analysis and monthly reconciliation of assigned entities.
• You prepare monthly, quarterly and year-end internal and group reports.
• You provide monitoring of costs, accruals and provisions in collaboration with the controlling team and local teams.
• You participate in the annual budgeting process.
• You foresee the closing of general ledger accounts and financial reporting.
• You participate in the annual external audit process if required.
• You will work closely with the Financial Controllers team in this process.
• You will always work on a country or entity based in Western Europe.

To fulfil this role of GL Accountant, you recognise yourself in the following profile:

• You hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Accounting.
• You have a first experience as a GL Accountant.
• You have a strong analytical mindset and attention to detail.
• You are fluent in English.
• You have a good knowledge of balance sheet analysis, monthly, quarterly, and yearly closing processes, IFRS, and reconciliations.
• SAP experience is advantageous.
• You are a team player who thrives in an international environment.

Robert Half is currently recruiting a Payment Infrastructure & Operations Expert (M/V/X) - Antwerp

Our client is an innovative and fast-growing organization active at the crossroads of technology, payments, and operations.

The scope of responsibilities for this job include:

• You ensure a stable and efficient payment operation by monitoring end-to-end payment flows and overseeing daily payment processing.
• You take ownership of the operational performance of the core banking and payments ecosystem and act as a subject matter expert for payment processes, systems, and controls.
• You investigate and resolve operational issues and complex exceptions by analyzing transaction data, reconciliations, payment statuses, and system information.
• You identify and implement structural improvements that enhance reliability, efficiency, and scalability across the payment landscape.
• You optimize, standardize, and document processes, controls, and ways of working to support operational excellence and reduce risk.
• You support business growth and change initiatives through impact assessments, testing activities, process enhancements, and system releases.
• You help maintain a controlled, resilient, and compliant operating environment by supporting internal controls, reporting, business continuity activities, and regulatory requirements.

The requested qualifications for this job as Payment Infrastructure & Operations Expert (M/V/X) include:

• You hold a bachelor's or master's degree in finance, Economics, Business Engineering, Information Technology, Statistics, or a related field, or you bring equivalent experience.
• You have experience in payments, banking operations, treasury, fintech, or another transaction-driven environment.
• You have a strong affinity with payment processes, operational controls, and system-driven operations, while experience with core banking platforms, payment systems, incident management, process improvement, or testing is a strong asset.
• You combine a strong operational mindset with analytical thinking and a hands-on, structured approach.
• You enjoy solving complex operational challenges, take ownership of outcomes, and keep oversight of the full payment lifecycle.
• You stay calm and solution-oriented in environments where reliability, accuracy, and continuity are critical, even when facing incidents, exceptions, or tight deadlines.
• You continuously look for opportunities to improve processes, controls, and ways of working.
• You are a collaborative team player who builds strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners.
• You communicate confidently and effectively in Dutch and English.

Krunch is a café-restaurant in Gent (De Pintelaan 172). We serve breakfast, lunch and homemade cakes. We are looking for an extra pair of hands in the kitchen.
 

The job
 
 

• Prep work (mise en place) 

• Cooking breakfast and lunch dishes

What we need

Robert Half is currently recruiting a Junior Accountant (M/V/X) - Antwerp.

Our client is an innovative organization with a long-term vision and a strong commitment to sustainable value creation. You will join a collaborative finance environment where strategy, finance and entrepreneurship come together in support of lasting growth.

The scope of responsibilities for this job as a Junior Accountant (M/V/X) include:

• You support the day-to-day accounting activities across multiple group entities and help ensure financial records are accurate, complete and up to date.
• You process invoices, bank transactions and journal entries, and contribute to the monthly, quarterly and annual closing processes.
• You assist in monitoring balance sheet accounts and help maintain a high level of financial accuracy and compliance.
• You contribute to the preparation of periodic financial reports for internal and external stakeholders.
• You support the preparation of statutory financial statements, audit documentation, reconciliations and balance sheet analyses.
• You help optimize and standardize accounting and financial processes within an evolving finance organization.
• You support the implementation of internal controls and accounting policies to strengthen the control environment and improve efficiency.
• You assist with finance-related projects, analyses and administrative tasks, and provide support to colleagues with financial questions.
 

 

The requested qualifications for this job include:

• You hold a bachelor's or master's degree in accountancy, Finance or a related field, combined with around three years of relevant professional experience.
• You have strong technical skills and an excellent command of Microsoft Excel.
• You have experience with SAP or another ERP system, which is considered a strong asset.
• You have a basic knowledge of IFRS, which is an advantage.
• You have an interest in or experience with real estate and/or private equity structures.
• You are analytical, accurate, proactive and eager to learn.
• You work well in a team and communicate smoothly with colleagues.
• You are fluent in Dutch and English, both written and spoken.

jobs.occupation: Warehouse Operator / Reach Truck Driver – 2 Shifts
jobs.description:
Are you someone who enjoys working in a warehouse and likes a varied working day? Do you have experience operating a reach truck, but also enjoy getting hands-on with order picking and other warehouse activities? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you!

Your responsibilities

As a Warehouse Operator, you play an important role in the logistics process. You ensure that goods are handled, moved and prepared for shipment correctly and efficiently.

Your duties will include:

• Picking orders and preparing them for shipment.

• Receiving and checking incoming goods.

• Storing products in the correct warehouse locations.

• Moving goods and pallets using a reach truck, for both inbound and outbound operations.

• Occasionally loading and unloading trucks using a forklift.

• Labelling products and registering them correctly in the system.

• Maintaining a clean, safe and well-organised working environment.

 

Your profile

We are looking for someone who enjoys a varied warehouse role and is flexible when it comes to different tasks.

In addition, you meet the following requirements:

• You have initial work experience as a reach truck operator.

• You hold a valid reach truck certificate.

• You have a good command of Dutch or English, both spoken and written.

• You are comfortable working with numbers and counting accurately.

• You are available to start at short notice.

• You are willing to perform various warehouse tasks, including operating the reach truck, order picking and checking goods.

• You are willing to work in a two-shift system.

Job description 

    
• No experience in car transport required (CE licence experience is essential)
    
• Working week: Mon–Fri (full-time; longer hours possible but not compulsory)
    
• You may take the lorry home – can leave from your place of residence
    
• Language: German or English (minimum)
    
• Candidates may live in Belgium (German payroll)

 Requirements 

National routes, with occasional trips across the border to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, or France.

No experience is required; we are looking for passion and motivation for vehicle transport.

A CE driving licence, Code 95 qualification, and a valid medical fitness certificate are required.

Job description 
 As a CE truck driver, you will be responsible for delivering various types of materials throughout Belgium. Whether it’s express deliveries, pallet transport, or construction-related materials, you’ll encounter a wide variety of jobs. Every day is different, while still offering a familiar routine. What does your day look like? 
    
• You start your day between 5:00 and 8:00 a.m. at our site in Bornem with a cup of coffee and a vehicle check.
    
• You will deliver various goods throughout Belgium. Occasionally, you may cross the border, but you will always return home at the end of the day.
    
• The number of daily stops depends on the schedule. Sometimes you may have just 1 stop, while on other days you could have up to 10.
 What are we looking for? 
    
• You have a CE driving licence and the required certificates.
    
• You have a valid ADR certificate.
    
• You are flexible, reliable, and customer-friendly.
    
• You are physically fit.
    
• You have experience as a CE truck driver.
    
• You have good knowledge of the road network.
    
• You have a good command of Dutch or English due to safety requirements.
 What can you expect from us? 
    
• A competitive salary.
    
• A great working atmosphere and the opportunity to drive modern, high-quality equipment.

Can you tick all the boxes above? Apply today and join our team!

 Requirements 

    
• You have a Category C driving licence and the required certificates.
    
• You have a valid ADR certificate.
    
• You are flexible, reliable, and customer-friendly.
    
• You are physically fit.
    
• You have experience as a Category C truck driver.
    
• You have good knowledge of the road network.
    
• You have a good command of Dutch or English due to safety requirements.

For a dynamic international company in Merchtem, we are looking for an Inside Sales Representative who combines customer service with commercial flair and a technical interest. You enjoy working in a role where you interact daily with customers, the sales team and internal departments, and where you can make a real impact on business growth and customer satisfaction.

In this role, you will be the main commercial and customer-oriented point of contact for your region. Working closely with the External Sales Representative, you will build strong customer relationships and help expand the customer portfolio. You will manage a combination of new and existing customers, ensuring that everything runs smoothly and professionally, from quotations to follow-up.

Your responsibilities

• Acquiring new customers and further developing existing customer relationships.
• Growing existing accounts through cross-selling and upselling.
• Preparing and following up on quotations and price calculations.
• Processing orders and encouraging customers to use the E-Shop.
• Maintaining daily customer contact by phone and email, with a focus on commercial growth.
• Keeping customer information up to date in ERP/CRM systems.
• Identifying customer needs and commercial opportunities.
• Acting as the first point of contact for customer questions and support.
• Working closely with the External Sales Representative on reporting and follow-up.

• You have a strong hunter mentality and a clear commercial drive to win new customers.
• You have a commercial and/or technical background.
• You have experience in B2B sales, preferably in a technical environment.
• You are fluent in both spoken and written French and English.
• Knowledge of Arabic is an advantage but not a requirement.
• You are comfortable working with Excel and general IT tools.
• You have strong communication skills and a commercial mindset.

The Logistics Centre in Grimbergen is recognized as one of the world's leading facilities, reflecting the company's commitment to excellence across all operations.

Jobomschrijving

For the maintenance department of our client located in Grimbergen, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to work rotating shifts (6:00-14:00 and 14:00-22:00).

This role requires strong technical knowledge, hands-on problem-solving skills, and a commitment to safety. You will troubleshoot mechanical and electrical issues, perform preventive maintenance, and respond promptly to repair requests.

Your main responsibilities as a Maintenance Technician:

• Maintain and repair automated systems as needed
• Perform maintenance and repairs on lift trucks
• Conduct electrical and mechanical maintenance on all equipment and installations
• Service and maintain order pickers, reach trucks, and combi trucks

The Maintenance Technician we are looking for possesses the following qualities:

• Engineering background
• Ability to work rotating shifts (6h-14h and 14h-22h)
• Hands-on and dynamic approach
• Precision and results-oriented mindset
• Takes initiative and assumes responsibility
• Team player who can also work independently
• Preferably experienced in welding
• Fluent in English; Dutch is a plus

We are looking for a motivated and hands-on Workshop Technician to join our technical team in Huizingen. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining, repairing, and preparing material handling equipment, ensuring our customers receive reliable and high-quality machines. This is an excellent opportunity for a technician who enjoys solving technical challenges and wants to work in a dynamic and growing environment. Key Responsibilities : 

 
• Perform preventive maintenance and repairs on warehouse and material handling equipment. 
 

 
• Diagnose mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic faults. 
 
•  
Prepare new equipment for delivery and commissioning. 

 
• Conduct inspections and quality checks. 
 

 
• Test equipment following repairs and maintenance work. 
 

 
• Complete service reports and technical documentation accurately. 
 

 
• Ensure compliance with health, safety, and quality standards. 
 

 
• Collaborate with colleagues to deliver excellent technical service. 

Technical education or relevant experience in mechanics, electromechanics, automotive technology, or a related field. Experience working on machinery, industrial vehicles, forklifts, or similar equipment is an advantage. 
Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills. Basic knowledge of electrical and hydraulic systems. 
Ability to work independently and as part of a team. 
Reliable, proactive, and solution-oriented. Valid Category B driving licence. 
Very good knowledge of English

Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? Are you already living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home almost every evening?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
• Average of 12h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Between 5 to 15 stops/day
• Never on weekends or on holidays
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence and code 95
• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby   truck cannot be taken home)
Experience as a CE truck driver is a big advantage but not required. You can also apply if you've just gotten your CE driving licence!
